about: ADR-0036: every screen version, template pair, aggregation version and judge registry a released build registered. An entry is never deleted. It leaves the build only when marked retired (no open deal binds it) or withdrawn (running it would break a hard rule), each with its decision reference. The default is what a primary on this build accepts new deals under; a new default ships in two deploys, carried first and default second.
